quote: Atlas Renewable Energy… has completed the sale of two operating solar assets in Uruguay… These assets, totaling 76 MWp of installed capacity, have been part of Atlas’ portfolio since the company’s early stages… Proceeds from the transaction will support Atlas’ continued growth across Latin America…
note: Opened Atlas 27 May 2026 English primary; plant names El Naranjal/Del Litoral from Ardian/PV magazine corroboration.
